description: Performs a focused text read from a known element by selector or canonical id for verification or extraction; use DOM.getAXTree first when the target element is not yet identified.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the target element.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the target element.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID from DOM.getAXTree.

purpose.description: Describe why this element text is needed, e.g., verifying a success message, reading a result section, or extracting submitted feedback
